name: Abhayagiri Vihāra
scope: The restored northern Abhayagiri stupa, cardinal entrance shrines and stone terrace in Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka.
era: Abhayagiri Stupa after the Central Cultural Fund conservation unveiled in 2015.

externalReferences.artist: James G. Smither, reproduced by Henry Parker

originalReview.notes: Figure 85 shows the measured elevation with the three basal rings, dome, square chamber and upper spire. Parker identifies this as the northern structure and explains why earlier titles swapped the two stupas. His hypothetical upper line documents an earlier proposed height.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. No image was marked public domain or CC0. Used the original 1909 measured drawing of the northern stupa, with current dimensions from the Central Cultural Fund and the Sri Lankan government.
